Entry.JapaneseText: 火事じゃ……ない…… なんだこれ？ お湯が、こんなに溜めてある
Entry.EnglishText: Wait, there’s no fire...? What is this place? I’ve never seen such a large hot bath!

Entry.JapaneseText: ははぁ、こりゃぁ驚いた！ あんたたちは温泉を知らんのかね？ どこの田舎から来なさった
Entry.EnglishText: Haha, well what have we here. Don’t tell me these kiddos have never seen a hot spring before? What sticks did you come from?

Entry.JapaneseText: いやいや、こいつだけだ
Entry.EnglishText: No, it's just this kid.

Entry.JapaneseText: いやいや、こいつだけです
Entry.EnglishText: No, it's just him.

Entry.JapaneseText: ええ!? だって シーブル村にこんなのないし…… <Kohaku>は知ってた？
Entry.EnglishText: Hey, don’t throw me under the bus! They don’t have anything like this back in Seable! Kohaku, did you know what this was?

Entry.JapaneseText: ……温泉。 地下から湧き出すお湯。 病気や怪我に効くのも……ある
Entry.EnglishText: ...A hot spring is a hot bath that forms from digging warm water from the ground. It supposedly can help heal your illnesses or injuries...

Entry.JapaneseText: ガァーーーン！ 知らないのはオレだけ……
Entry.EnglishText: Whaaat?! I really was the only one who didn’t know...

Entry.JapaneseText: ……温泉タマモ。 人肌のお湯で……育つ作物。 実はトロッと半熟で……栄養満点
Entry.EnglishText: ...There’s seaweed here. It grows on the outside of the spring. It’s best when it’s... soft boiled.

Entry.JapaneseText: おお〜、お嬢ちゃん詳しいねぇ
Entry.EnglishText: Well, don’t you know your stuff!

Entry.JapaneseText: この村に久しぶりに お客さんが戻ってくれて嬉しいよ。 ゆっくりしていってくだされ
Entry.EnglishText: It’s been a while since we had visitors. Please, make yourselves at home.

Entry.JapaneseText: へぇ、温泉タマモかぁ。 美味しそうだねぇ
Entry.EnglishText: Seaweed, huh? It sure looks yummy!
Uh oh, run!

Entry.JapaneseText: もぉ〜〜〜あんたたち！ また、お風呂を覗いたわね!!
Entry.EnglishText: Get back here, guys! That’s the last time you peep on me in the bath!

Entry.JapaneseText: ごめんなさい、お客さん。 あの子たち、また外で遊べるように なったのが嬉しくて、つい……
Entry.EnglishText: I’m sorry everyone. Those kids are just excited that they got to play outside again, so they’re up to no good.

Entry.JapaneseText: へ〜ん、ペッタンコの サーシャ姉ちゃんなんか のぞいても面白くないよ〜だ！
Entry.EnglishText: Pah! Who wants to see your cutting board chest anyway!
What was that?!
Awawa!

Entry.JapaneseText: あぅぅ〜〜〜確かに ドロドロの半熟だぁ……
Entry.EnglishText: Oof... Well, that’s one way to find out the temperature...

Entry.JapaneseText: すまんのぅ。お嬢ちゃんたち どうぞ村の温泉で 汚れを落してくだされ
Entry.EnglishText: I’m so sorry for this. Why don’t you girls come get cleaned up in the hot springs?

Entry.JapaneseText: こりゃ！ サーシャも、ちゃんと謝らんか!!
Entry.EnglishText: Sasha, you ought to apologize to them too!
Take a bath... in the hot springs...

Entry.JapaneseText: <Kohaku>、スト〜〜〜ップ！ 脱ぐのは、あっちだよ!!
Entry.EnglishText: <Kohaku>, wait! Don’t get changed HERE! Go over THERE!
...Why not?
Just listen to me!

Entry.JapaneseText: …………<Kohaku> 知識はあっても 感情がまだまだ足りないんだね
Entry.EnglishText: ...She may be smart, but without her emotions, she doesn't make rational decisions, huh.

Entry.JapaneseText: 落ちこんでるヒマがあったら動け！
Entry.EnglishText: If you have time to mope, you have time to get moving!

Entry.JapaneseText: 客が来るのも 子どもが外で遊ぶのも久しぶり…… この村には何かあったんだ
Entry.EnglishText: It’s been a while since they had visitors or kids playing outdoors. Just what happened here?

Entry.JapaneseText: この村に、おかしな事など 何も起こっておらんですよ……
Entry.EnglishText: Nothing strange has happened in this village, I assure you.

Entry.JapaneseText: …………お察しくだされ。 観光で暮らしている村に 悪い噂は困るのです
Entry.EnglishText: This is just an assumption, but I think a terrible rumor has been spread among our sightseeing village.

Entry.JapaneseText: だめだ……デスピル病が 起こったみたいだけど 誰も詳しく教えてくれない……
Entry.EnglishText: It’s no use, there’s totally a case of despir going around, but nobody will tell us about it...

Entry.JapaneseText: …………あの、ごめんなさい。 みんな私が悪いんです。 村の人たちを悪く思わないで……
Entry.EnglishText: I’m sorry everyone. That was my fault. Please don’t think poorly of the people here...

Entry.JapaneseText: サーシャさん、教えてよ！ この村で何が起こったの？
Entry.EnglishText: Sasha! Can you tell us what happened here?

Entry.JapaneseText: …………ごめんなさい。 村の悪い噂は困るんです
Entry.EnglishText: ...I’m sorry. All I can say is that there’s a nasty rumor going around.

Entry.JapaneseText: ある女の子を助ける手がかりが 欲しいだけなんだ。誰にも 喋らないから教えてください！
Entry.EnglishText: We just need to know in order to help a friend of ours. Nobody else will tell us, so please!
...No use, let’s ask somebody else.

Entry.JapaneseText: …………ある夜、お風呂に 入っていた私の中に 流星のような光が飛びこんだの
Entry.EnglishText: ...One night, I saw a shooting star while I was in the bath.

Entry.JapaneseText: それ以来、私は人の視線が 恥ずかしくて、誰にも会えなく なってしまったんです
Entry.EnglishText: Ever since then, I’d been embarrassed seeing other people, so I didn’t see other people anymore.

Entry.JapaneseText: その『恥じらい病』は村の 人たちにも伝染して、みんな外に 出られなくなってしまった……
Entry.EnglishText: That “shyness disease” had spread to the other members of the village, so nobody went outside anymore...

Entry.JapaneseText: 布団の中に引きこもり 飢え死にしそうになる人まで 出たんです
Entry.EnglishText: They holed up in their rooms, only leaving when they felt they were going to starve to death.

Entry.JapaneseText: サーシャさん…… 教えてくれて、ありがとう
Entry.EnglishText: Sasha... thank you for telling us.

Entry.JapaneseText: いいの。村の都合だけを考えて あの恐ろしいデスピル病を隠す 事こそ、恥ずかしいと思うから
Entry.EnglishText: It's fine. The mayor just wants to cover up the whole despir situation in the village out of shame.

Entry.JapaneseText: で、そのデスピル病を どうやって回復させたんだ？
Entry.EnglishText: Then, how did you recover from it?

Entry.JapaneseText: 旅のバレイア教の騎士様が 私のスピリアから、不思議な 光る石を取り出してくれたんです
Entry.EnglishText: A Crystal Knight was passing through, and he removed this weird glowing stone from my Spiria.

Entry.JapaneseText: それだけで、村中の人が 同時に治っちゃったの
Entry.EnglishText: And just like that, it spread throughout the whole village.

Entry.JapaneseText: バレイア教の結晶騎士に スピルーンを回収された!? そいつはどこに行ったの？
Entry.EnglishText: A Velleia Crystal Knight took the Spirune?! Where is he now?

Entry.JapaneseText: 騎士様には、せめてものお礼に 村の温泉に入ってもらってます
Entry.EnglishText: I wanted to do something to thank him, so I insisted he visit the hot spring.
Did you say... the hot spring?!
The girls are in danger!

Entry.JapaneseText: はわぁ〜〜〜気持ちいいねぇ <Kohaku>ぅ…………
Entry.EnglishText: Ahhh, the water feels sooo nice, right <Kohaku>?
The water is... just right.

Entry.JapaneseText: ちょっとぉ、湯船にタオルを つけるんじゃないよっ！
Entry.EnglishText: Hey, quit hogging the towels!
Oops, 'scuse me-

Entry.JapaneseText: あーーーあんたたちはッ！
Entry.EnglishText: Aaah, it's YOU!
Whoa, what are YOU doing here?!

Entry.JapaneseText: け、結晶騎士、スピルーンを返せ！
Entry.EnglishText: G-Go on Crystal Knight, give the Spirune back!

Entry.JapaneseText: はあぁッ!? 覗きしたケダモノが逆ギレたぁ いい度胸だね？
Entry.EnglishText: Excuse me?! You really have the guts to order me around AFTER barging in on us, you lil perv?!

Entry.JapaneseText: そ、それは……ごめんなさい
Entry.EnglishText: A-About that... I'm sorry.

Entry.JapaneseText: お前こそ、いい度胸してんな。 今度は<Kohaku>を 人質にはとれねぇぜ？
Entry.EnglishText: You've got guts, showing your face to us. You're not gonna go kidnapping <Kohaku> again, are you?

Entry.JapaneseText: ち、ちょっと声デカイ！ 隊長に聞こえちゃうでしょ!?
Entry.EnglishText: S-shut it! What if my captain finds out?!

Entry.JapaneseText: なるほど……人質をとった上 こんな田舎ソーマ使いたちに 負けたのか、ペリドット？
Entry.EnglishText: I've heard more than enough. So, you took a girl hostage from these countryside Somatics, huh?

Entry.JapaneseText: 結晶騎士の恥め。 帝都に戻ったら 相応の罰を覚悟しろ
Entry.EnglishText: You're a disgrace to Crystal Knights. Prepare for a harsh scolding once we return to the capital.

Entry.JapaneseText: うう…… 了解です、隊長……
Entry.EnglishText: Ugh... yes, Captain...

Entry.JapaneseText: 隊長？ 村を救った騎士は お前だったのか、カルセドニー
Entry.EnglishText: Captain? Does that mean you were the Crystal Knight who saved this village?

Entry.JapaneseText: ふ……いつぞやの少年か？ すまんが、スピルーンを 返す訳にはいかない
Entry.EnglishText: Hmph. If it isn't that boy from earlier. My apologies, but I can not simply hand over this Spirune.

Entry.JapaneseText: このスピルーンとデスピル病…… そして先夜の謎の爆発の因果関係を 確かめねばならないのでな
Entry.EnglishText: Not until I can accertain the connection this Spirune has with despir... as well as that explosion form last night.
But it belongs to <Kohaku>!

Entry.JapaneseText: お前たちも気付いているはずだ。 このスピルーンが、あの魔物…… ゼロムを活発化させていると！
Entry.EnglishText: Surely you noticed it too? It's this Spirune that is awakaneing those beasts... the xerom!

Entry.JapaneseText: それとも、その少女さえ 回復すれば、世界にデスピル病が あふれても関係ないと言うのか？
Entry.EnglishText: Are you proposing so long as long as this girl is cured, the rest of the world can run rampant with despir for all you care?
I-I never said...

Entry.JapaneseText: 隊長、隊長、どうせなら この娘ごと連れ去っちゃえば いいじゃないですかぁ？
Entry.EnglishText: Hey Captain, why don't why just drag this girl along with us?

Entry.JapaneseText: ……いや、このスピルーンだけで 十分だ。部下が卑怯な真似をした 詫びに、少女は見逃してやろう
Entry.EnglishText: ...That won't be necessary, this Spirune is enough. As an apology for my subordinate's cowardly actions, I shall let it slide.
Oh, come on...

Entry.JapaneseText: 『見逃してやろう』だと？ てめぇは何様だッ!!
Entry.EnglishText: You'll “let it slide”? Who the hell do you think you are?!
Gah?!
Hisui...!

Entry.JapaneseText: やれやれ……教主様から 緊急召集がかかったというのに 長湯だな、バイロクス？
Entry.EnglishText: Goodness. Enjoying your relaxing bath, Byrox? Need I remind you Father summoned us here for an emergency?

Entry.JapaneseText: 申し訳ありません、隊長。 ですが、軍への示威目的の 作戦など気乗りしません
Entry.EnglishText: My apologies, Captain. However, I must say I am reluctant to carry out militant tactics such as this.

Entry.JapaneseText: バカ者、下された命令に従うのが 騎士の務めだ。これより我が隊は 急ぎ帝都エストレーガに帰還する！
Entry.EnglishText: Don't be foolish, it is a knights duty to obey the orders given to him. With that said, we must return to Estraga at once!
Huh?!

Entry.JapaneseText: へ〜い。 あーあ……もう二、三日 温泉で癒されたかったなぁ
Entry.EnglishText: Yeah yeah... Man, why couldn't I have at least a few more days relaxing in the hot springs?
W-Wait...

Entry.JapaneseText: 不満なら、いつでも斬りかかって 来ていいぞ、少年。だが……
Entry.EnglishText: If you are displeased, you are welcome to cross my blade any time, boy. However

Entry.JapaneseText: そんな定まらないスピリアで 振うソーマなど、棒切れほどの 力もないと知れ
Entry.EnglishText: A Soma swung with a wavering Spiria wields no more powerful than a mere stick.
Tch...

Entry.JapaneseText: そういえば、このグースで 初めてカルセドニーたちと 戦ったんだっけ
Entry.EnglishText: Man I just remembered, this is where we first battled you and your squad.

Entry.JapaneseText: 戦った？ 正しくは『叩きのめされた』だな
Entry.EnglishText: Battle? I'd say “humiliating defeat” is more accurate.

Entry.JapaneseText: へん！ 今やったら 逆の結果になるはずだけどね
Entry.EnglishText: Heh! I bet if we fought again right now, you wouldn't stand a chance!

Entry.JapaneseText: ふっ、妄想をいくら伝えても 私のスピリアには響かんぞ？
Entry.EnglishText: Hmph, you needn't try and comfort me with your delusional flattery.

Entry.JapaneseText: あ〜〜〜っ、思い出した！ 温泉に入ってるのを あんたに覗かれたんだっけ!!
Entry.EnglishText: DUDE, I just remembered! Didn't you sneak a peek at me while I was in the bath?!

Entry.JapaneseText: そうだっ！ ボクも <Kohaku>も覗かれたんだ！
Entry.EnglishText: That's right! Kohaku and I were in there too!

Entry.JapaneseText: 貴様がそんな ハレンチ漢だったとは……
Entry.EnglishText: I had no idea you were such a shameless degenerate...

Entry.JapaneseText: ご、誤解だよ！ オレは見てないってばッ!! …………ちょっとしか
Entry.EnglishText: N-No, you've got it all wrong! I didn't see anything! At least... not on purpose.
EEEK~!
Who was that?! Sounds like it came from the plaza!
Ah, it's you guys...

Entry.JapaneseText: 何があった！ ゼロムに襲われたのか？
Entry.EnglishText: Tell us what happened! Are the xerom attacking?

Entry.JapaneseText: ちがうよ。 紫のローブの魔道士が サーシャ姉ちゃんを脅したんだ
Entry.EnglishText: No. That witch in the weird purple robes was threatening Sasha.

Entry.JapaneseText: ぼくたち姉ちゃんを 守ろうとしたんだけど…… あいつ強くって……
Entry.EnglishText: I tried to protect her, but that mage lady was really strong...

Entry.JapaneseText: 紫ローブの魔道士—— インカローズかッ！
Entry.EnglishText: A witch in purple robes? That has to be Incarose!

Entry.JapaneseText: フルエーレの場所を言わないと この子たちを殺すって……
Entry.EnglishText: She said if I don't tell her where the Fluere are, she'll kill these kids.

Entry.JapaneseText: 私、恐ろしくて泉の場所を 教えてしまった。どうしよう…… 泉には村長がいるのに
Entry.EnglishText: I was always taught they were found in an incredibly sacred place. What do we do? The mayor's still at the spring...

Entry.JapaneseText: インカローズが なんでフルエーレを……？
Entry.EnglishText: What could Incarose want with the Fluere?

Entry.JapaneseText: もしかして、クリードが……
Entry.EnglishText: It's most likely by Creed's orders...

Entry.JapaneseText: どうせ、ろくな理由じゃねぇさ！ 泉に急ぐぞッ
Entry.EnglishText: Who cares what her reasons are? We gotta hurry to the spring!

Entry.JapaneseText: 待って、インカローズって 教会と軍を裏から あおってたって魔道士だろ？
Entry.EnglishText: Hold up, Incarose was that mage that was stirring up trouble in the church from behind the scenes, yeah?

Entry.JapaneseText: いい機会だ。 あたしたちに借りを返させてよ
Entry.EnglishText: This is perfect. Time for us to get payback!

Entry.JapaneseText: カル様、ここは 例の作戦でいきましょう
Entry.EnglishText: Lord Chal, I suggest we proceed with our usual strategy.
Heh. An excellent idea.

Entry.JapaneseText: <Shing> お前たちは泉に向かってくれ。 我々は別行動をとらせてもらう
Entry.EnglishText: You all head to the spring. We'll be handling this ourselves.

Entry.JapaneseText: ああっ、みなさん！ なんてひどい火傷を!?
Entry.EnglishText: Oh, you're back! Oh no, what awful burns?!

Entry.JapaneseText: オレたちは平気だよ。 それよりカルセドニーの 手当てをさせてくれ
Entry.EnglishText: Don't worry about us. Chalcedony's the one who needs help right now.

Entry.JapaneseText: は、はい！ 急いで村長の家へ来てください!!
Entry.EnglishText: O-Of course! Hurry on into the mayor's house!!

Entry.JapaneseText: カルセドニー…… 限界以上の思念力をふり絞った 反動がでてしまったのですね
Entry.EnglishText: Chalcedony... he must've have pushed your Will beyond he's physical limits.

Entry.JapaneseText: それはリチア様も同様です！ これ以上の思念術の使用は……
Entry.EnglishText: The same applies to you, Master Lithia! If you continue to use your Will Artes...
It won't be long before... you calcify!

Entry.JapaneseText: リチア……お前のスピリアは こんなにも……
Entry.EnglishText: Lithia... so your Spiria's only hanging on by a thread...

Entry.JapaneseText: ふたりとも……この事は 皆には黙っていてください
Entry.EnglishText: Both of you, I beg you... please keep this a secret between us.
I won't allow it!

Entry.JapaneseText: ……良いのです。 ガルデニアを封じぬうちに 死んだりはしませんわ
Entry.EnglishText: ...It's alright. I won't let myself die before I can seal away Gardenia once and for all.
Curry is culture.
Mabo is also culture.

Entry.JapaneseText: そしてカレーとマーボーを 合わせたマーボーカレー……
Entry.EnglishText: And when you add them together to make Mabo Curry...
Mm-hm! Positively scrumptious!

Entry.JapaneseText: これぞ文化の進化なりぃ！
Entry.EnglishText: This is how culture evolves!

Entry.JapaneseText: むっふふ……『文化』『進化』と 韻をふむ事で、小生の知性を 際立たせる作戦、大・成・功！
Entry.EnglishText: Heh. Rhyming “culture” and evolution", my intellect truly knows no bounds!

Entry.JapaneseText: な、なんだこいつ!? 魔物がしゃべってる！
Entry.EnglishText: Wh-What's going on?! That monster just talked!

Entry.JapaneseText: 失敬な！ 小生は魔物ではないっ！
Entry.EnglishText: Excuse you, I am no monster!
...A talking... raccooon...

Entry.JapaneseText: タヌキでもな〜〜〜い！ 小生は『ウィンダム』なりっ！
Entry.EnglishText: I'm not a raccoon, either! I am the one known as Windum!

Entry.JapaneseText: まったく、文化的でない 人間とは話にくい事この上なし
Entry.EnglishText: My goodness, it's impossible to talk to such uncultured people.

Entry.JapaneseText: ……とにかく、小生は 強い思念力を持った ソーマ使いを捜していたのだ
Entry.EnglishText: Putting that aside, I'm looking for a Somatic, one with a strong Will.

Entry.JapaneseText: うわっ、この指輪は!? と、取れない……？
Entry.EnglishText: Whoa, what's with this ring!?! It comes off?

Entry.JapaneseText: それは『ソーサラーリング』
Entry.EnglishText: That is the “Sorcerer's Ring”.

Entry.JapaneseText: ソーマ使いの思念力を 様々な形に変えて放出する 不思議アイテムなり
Entry.EnglishText: It's a mysterious relic that channels a Somatics Will power into different forms.

Entry.JapaneseText: むっふふふ…… せいぜい文化的＆知的に 使用するがよい
Entry.EnglishText: Hehehe... best use it for intellectual and cultural purposes!

Entry.JapaneseText: あのタヌキめぇ〜！ 芸術家のボクに向かって 文化的じゃないって言ったぁ〜！
Entry.EnglishText: Grr that little raccoon! How dare he call me, an ARTIST, uncultured?!

Entry.JapaneseText: マーボーカレーを食べながら しゃべるタヌキ…… 俺は夢でも見たのか？
Entry.EnglishText: That raccoon was crapping on while eating mabo curry... what kinda weird dream is this?

Entry.JapaneseText: ……夢じゃないよ。 ほら、本当に指輪がある
Entry.EnglishText: ...That was no dream. Look, I've still got the ring.

Entry.JapaneseText: ソーサラーリング…… これって一体……？
Entry.EnglishText: “Sorcerer's Ring” huh... what the heck is this thing?

Entry.JapaneseText: お前…… なんか呪われたんじゃないか？
Entry.EnglishText: Dude... did you just get cursed?

Entry.JapaneseText: ナムナム…… 呪われた人からは 離れなきゃねぇ
Entry.EnglishText: Nuh-uh... I'm not taking any chances with no curse!

Entry.JapaneseText: ソーサラーリングは 思念力を様々な形に変えて 放出するアイテムです
Entry.EnglishText: The Sorcerer's Ring is an item that tranforms Will power in various ways.

Entry.JapaneseText: Ｙボタンを押してみてください
Entry.EnglishText: Try pressing the Y button.
WAAAHH!!

Entry.JapaneseText: こらぁ〜〜〜っ!! ボクを、燃えキャラに する気かぁっ!?
Entry.EnglishText: Hot hot hot! Watch where you're pointing that thing!

Entry.JapaneseText: ご、ごめん！ まさか炎が出るなんて 思わなくて……
Entry.EnglishText: I-I'm so sorry! I didn't know it was gonna shoot fire...

Entry.JapaneseText: はっははは〜 こりゃ便利だ！ 色々使い道がありそうだぜ♪
Entry.EnglishText: Bahaha! This thing looks handy! I reckon we could use this on a ton of things! ♪

Entry.JapaneseText: Ｙボタンを押すと エナジーショットを 発射可能です
エナジーショットは ヒットした物を燃やしたり エネルギーを注入したりできます

Entry.EnglishText: %s
